causalSequence: preheat oven 160-180 C; grease 1.5 L (6 cup) baking dish; set dish on lined tray
whisk melted butter, milk, egg together
sift in flour, cocoa; add sugar; whisk to smooth batter
mix sauce cocoa + sugar; sprinkle evenly over batter
pour boiling water gently over back of a spoon
bake 30-50 min until top set and springy, sauce wobbly beneath
rest 5 min; dust with icing sugar; serve warm with cream or ice cream
techniqueFacts: cocoa-sugar topping plus boiling water sinks as the cake rises, forming the sauce underneath (all sources)
pour the water over the back of a spoon so it doesn't dent the batter (3 sources)
doneness is top set but very wobbly beneath; overbaking dries up the sauce (2 sources warn)
bake time tracks dish depth: 30 min in a shallow dish up to 50 min in a deep 17 cm dish; wider dish cuts 5-10 min (s3)
brown sugar in the sauce layer is the common choice (s2, s3; s1 optional)
one source dissolves the topping in a jug with the boiling water first to avoid cocoa clumps (s1)
egg-free version works (s1); 1 egg is standard elsewhere
oven temps observed: 160 C fan (s0), 180 C (s1), 170 C (s2), 180 C / 160 C fan (s3)
best served immediately; sauce thickens fudgy as it cools; fridge leftovers 2-4 days, no freezing (2 sources)
